name: Adaptive Differentiable Grids for Cryo-ET
aliases: Adaptive density grids based on an octree structure
definition: A learning-based representation of the density field of a captured sample using an octree structure where each node represents a 3D density grid optimized from captured projections during training, combining differentiable image formation with regularization.
summary: Adaptive Differentiable Grids is a cryo-ET reconstruction method using adaptive octrees and trilinear interpolation to denoise data and accelerate rendering compared to traditional neural fields.
